description: Defines QoS parameter structures for 5QI descriptors, QoS characteristics, GBR QoS flow info, and related classes within the ocudu namespace.

classes.name: dyn_5qi_descriptor
classes.description: Represents a dynamic 5QI descriptor with QoS parameters.

classes.name: non_dyn_5qi_descriptor
classes.description: Represents a non-dynamic 5QI descriptor with QoS parameters.

classes.name: qos_characteristics
classes.description: Encapsulates either a dynamic or non-dynamic 5QI descriptor.

classes.name: gbr_qos_flow_information
classes.description: Contains GBR QoS flow parameters such as max/min bit rates and packet loss rates.

classes.name: alloc_and_retention_priority
classes.description: Defines priority and preemption capabilities for QoS flows.

classes.name: qos_flow_level_qos_parameters
classes.description: Aggregates QoS descriptor, priority, GBR info, and related attributes for a QoS flow.
